episodes.title: Antarctica
episodes.summary: Interested in having a girlfriend, Sam researches dating advice and puts it to the test. Meanwhile, his overprotective mom Elsa must learn to let go.

episodes.title: A Human Female
episodes.summary: When Sam learns his crush is already taken, dad Doug helps him woo her. A lost credit card sends Elsa back to the bar. Casey hears rumors about Evan.

episodes.title: Julia Says
episodes.summary: Sam decides to update his look. Casey learns a family secret. Feeling like her family no longer needs her, Elsa seeks attention elsewhere.

episodes.title: A Nice Neutral Smell
episodes.summary: When a classmate shows interest in him, Sam makes a list of pros and cons to see whether she's girlfriend material. Casey gets a prestigious offer.

episodes.title: That's My Sweatshirt
episodes.summary: Sam becomes rattled after Paige invades his bedroom. Casey visits Clayton Prep and gets a taste of what life away from her brother would be like.

episodes.title: The D-Train to Bone Town
episodes.summary: Paige proposes having an autism-friendly school dance to the PTA. Sam makes preparations for losing his virginity. Doug and Julia help each other.

episodes.title: I Lost My Poor Meatball
episodes.summary: When Paige makes a confession to Sam, he creates a checklist to figure how he feels. Things with Nick suddenly get too real for Elsa.

episodes.title: The Silencing Properties of Snow
episodes.summary: After a disastrous dinner with Paige's family, Sam makes amends at the school dance. Casey's fury at her mom affects her relationship with Evan.

episodes.title: Juiced!
episodes.summary: Sam's frustration at being unable to find a therapist and Casey's anxiety about going to a new school spark a blowup between the two.

episodes.title: Penguin Cam and Chill
episodes.summary: Casey feels less than welcome at Clayton. Sam asks Paige to spell out the rules of their "casual relationship", while Doug sets boundaries with Elsa.

episodes.title: Little Dude and the Lion
episodes.summary: A peer group meeting leads Sam to an important decision. Detention with Izzie shows Casey they have more in common than she thought.

episodes.title: Pants on Fire
episodes.summary: Zahid teaches Sam to lie, while Elsa practices being honest. Evan helps Casey get over an embarrassment. A doctor visit forces Julia out of denial.

episodes.title: The Egg Is Pipping
episodes.summary: In peer group, Sam realizes he needs to manage his own money. Doug gets advice from Megan on dealing with Elsa. Evan meets Casey's new friends.

episodes.title: In the Dragon's Lair
episodes.summary: To prepare for college life, Sam sleeps over at Zahid's. Sam's $700 loss reunites Doug and Elsa with Arlo's parents, former friends of theirs.

episodes.title: The Smudging
episodes.summary: Casey tells Izzie what Nate did. Sam tries to figure out which colleges to apply to. Doug discovers a need to educate first responders about autism.

episodes.title: Living at an Angle
episodes.summary: Sam loses his portfolio for his art school application and panics. Megan gets flirty with Doug, who makes a decision about Elsa. Julia calls Miles.

episodes.title: Ritual-licious
episodes.summary: Ignoring Casey's wishes, Elsa throws her a big birthday party, while Sam insists on following a decade-old birthday ritual. The bartender haunts Doug.

episodes.title: Ernest Shackleton's Rules for Survival
episodes.summary: Cruel yearbook comments show Sam who's got his back, a favor he repays at graduation. Feelings for Izzie confuse Casey. Elsa asks Doug a key question.

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans
episodes.summary: Paige invites Sam to redefine their romance, Casey struggles with complicated feelings, and Elsa attempts to find a new normal with Doug.

episodes.title: Standing Sam
episodes.summary: Sam makes a bold move amid the buzz of orientation day. Casey crosses paths with Nate. Elsa and Doug unpack the hazards of half-truths.

episodes.title: Cocaine Pills and Pony Meat
episodes.summary: An ethics professor pushes Sam to his limits. Elsa keeps an eye on Doug ... and Megan. Casey considers her future and encourages Evan to do the same.

episodes.title: Y.G.A.G.G.
episodes.summary: Casey and Evan take to the open road for a tense reunion. Back home, Sam and Zahid get ready to party, and Elsa bids farewell to the past.

episodes.title: Only Tweed
episodes.summary: As Paige makes a plan in the face of adversity, Sam awaits a crucial academic update. Elsa endures an uncomfortable encounter.

episodes.title: The Essence of a Penguin
episodes.summary: Sam's art assignment inspires an impromptu field trip. Casey navigates a fight with Izzie. Evan works hard for a second chance with Doug.

episodes.title: Shrinkage
episodes.summary: While Sam and Casey face friendship dilemmas, Elsa uncovers a charming surprise, and Doug makes an unexpected decision.

episodes.title: Road Rage Paige
episodes.summary: A hard truth keeps Casey up at night. Sam experiences a rough season with Zahid -- and Paige. Elsa and Doug brace for their next chapter.

episodes.title: Sam Takes a Walk
episodes.summary: As Sam gets political with his art, Elsa and Doug explore a (not-so-normal) weekend away. Casey and Izzie re-examine their relationship.

episodes.title: Searching for Brown Sugar Man
episodes.summary: A rogue plan for Zahid leads to a last-minute mission for Sam, Casey, Paige and Abby. Meanwhile, Doug faces a major test and makes a pivotal choice.

episodes.title: Magical Bird #1
episodes.summary: Sam's living situation with Zahid gets off to a rocky start, while Elsa struggles with her son's departure. Casey weighs telling Doug about Izzie.

episodes.title: Master of Penguins
episodes.summary: Casey's demanding schedule starts affecting her grades, while Sam seeks out some extra credit himself. A chance run-in revives old suspicions for Elsa.

episodes.title: You Say You Want a Revolution
episodes.summary: A change at work leaves Sam scrambling for cash. When Izzie fights the school dress code, Casey feels conflicted. Paige discovers a knack for management.

episodes.title: Starters and Endings
episodes.summary: Casey and Izzie face fallout from the protest. Paige tries to prove her mettle to Casey through strange tasks. Doug avoids dealing with a painful loss.

episodes.title: Dead Dreams
episodes.summary: As Sam gets ready for an adventure, Elsa thinks about ways to discourage him. Casey gets an up-close look at Izzie's tense home life.

episodes.title: Are You in Fair Health?
episodes.summary: Sam seeks a worthy caretaker for Edison. Casey tries to be supportive of Izzie, but her plan backfires. Zahid shares tough news with Sam.

episodes.title: Channel the Cat
episodes.summary: Elsa makes a meaningful reconnection. Paige plans a romantic night with Sam. Pressure mounts on Casey ahead of a big track meet.

episodes.title: Magical Bird #2
episodes.summary: As Casey reaches a crossroads, she finds herself questioning a lot of things. But in the meantime, she helps Sam get over a hurdle of his own.

episodes.title: Player's Ball
episodes.summary: Casey and Sam fume about their parents meddling in their lives. Zahid hosts a big send-off for something near and dear.

episodes.title: Dessert at Olive Garden
episodes.summary: Sam deals with a big disappointment, Casey clashes with Elsa over college plans, and a recurring dream vexes Doug.
